SELECT 
  r.year,
  AVG(
    CAST(substr(re.time, 1, instr(re.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 +
    CAST(substr(re.time, instr(re.time, ':') + 1, instr(substr(re.time, instr(re.time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
    CAST(substr(re.time, instr(re.time, ':') + instr(substr(re.time, instr(re.time, ':') + 1), ':') + 1) AS REAL)
  ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM results re
JOIN races r ON re.raceId = r.raceId
